reviews.title: Expensive for too few options
reviews.text: I had this app for a few months to keep track of caregiving for my elderly mother. For $20/mo you can only input once a day and I think most family caregivers stop in multiple times. This app has a lot of development needed to charge the high price it is.

reviews.title: No log in.
reviews.text: I got a new phone and I had to download the app again. It wants me to pay for the app all over again. When I literally got it less than 6 months ago and I payed the full year subscription. Not only does the app don’t support  a log in but even tho I’m using the same email I lost all my hours from my previous 2 weeks and all my notes. I do painting so my schedule is never the same. Sometimes I work until night sometimes I have to run do estimates etc etc I never have the same schedule and I liked this app because I could put notes down as well but getting a new phone and having to pay for the same app after loosing my data to me it’s ridiculous. It should have a log in so that way they won’t charge us again and I’m not even that mad about the paying but I am very upset  because I lost all my hours. This makes the app not reliable. 0/10

reviews.title: Changed Layout
reviews.text:
The new update changed the layout to show the FIRST timesheets, not the LAST. This is HIGHLY inconvenient as you have to open up the full sheet and scroll all the way down to find your most recent timesheet. 

There is currently NO option to change things back. I’ve had many issues because of this change. I need to see last week’s hours, not the beginning of the year!!!! Please give us an option to change. This is frustrating and I will be moving platforms/apps if there is no solution/fix/alternative.
